summary: Two backcountry skiers — James Sutton of Durango and Jurgen Montgomery of Pagosa Springs — caught, buried and killed in a skier-triggered avalanche in a burn area southeast of Vallecito Reservoir; Flight for Life helicopter spotted tracks entering the debris, ground crews recovered bodies ~3:36am; airbags equipped but neither deployed
responding_agency: La Plata County SAR + La Plata County Sheriff, Flight for Life, CAIC
notes: approx; left 7am Saturday, reported missing 9:18pm; buried ~4 ft deep
